items.title: Task #11: exact rational planar propagator checkpoint
items.summary: The corrected Rust release run computes the requested rational propagator expression with exact Laurent coefficients for n=4..8, including all 132 n=8 triangulations, and records deterministic integer assignments, finite-z tail certificates, reducer equality, cancellation orders, and timings.
observations: The primary generic-a run has exact rational coefficients and a nonzero leading order for every n=4..8; no nontrivial cancellation was observed in the generic families.
The special-alternating signed control is explicitly nongeneric and produces a leading-coefficient cancellation at n=4, with cancellation order 1 and the first surviving coefficient reported exactly.
Every primary case has exact finite-z checks at z=1009,1013,1019 whose errors lie within the summed geometric tail bound.
The n=8 primary case enumerates 132 triangulations; the Catalan counts n=4..9 verify as 2, 5, 14, 42, 132, 429.
The actual Rust release generator completed the full primary run; HVM execution remains a separate unavailable runtime.
uncertainties_and_limits: No published g-vector definition was sourced; w_e are declared channel weights, not g-vectors.
Published worlds-at-infinity are not reproduced, and no physical amplitude or canonical infinity limit is claimed.
HVM, HVM2, and Bend are not installed; the HVM file is a design-only export with no external runtime result.
Published n=5/6/7 validation formulas and conventions were unavailable or underspecified, so no comparison fixture was fabricated.
